proposal: TSO to confirm that 50 kA includes the Alpilla units.
question: ALP-OWN-ELE-001 gives 40 kA (2029) and 50 kA (2035 planning) at the plant 380 kV busbar; the GIS is specified for 50 kA (ER-11.01). The Alpilla generators add about 3.7 kA (GT 2.4 kA, ST 1.3 kA). Please confirm whether the TSO values include the Alpilla contribution; if not, 50 kA would be exceeded in 2035.
response: The TSO confirms (letter of 2026-09-25) that 40 kA (2029) and 50 kA (2035) include the contribution of the Alpilla units. The GIS rating of 50 kA stands.
subject: Short-circuit level at TP-E1: plant contribution
